slides.headlineRest: Offered by GMO After FX Trading Cloud Breach
slides.body: Japan's GMO Internet Group is offering up to $1 million for information leading to the arrest of hackers who breached its Onamae.com Desktop Cloud service. The company refused an extortion demand, prompting the launch of this reward program on October 28. The compromised service hosts Windows desktops primarily used for FX trading. Tips are eligible for a reward only if they result in an arrest or an international wanted notice.
